model.name: Current-task has ONE definition site — pinRole reads the designation resolver, not a parallel guess (Tron-caught second-source)
model.description: Current-task selection has EXACTLY ONE definition site. Tron set a task current, but a different task RENDERS current, because there are TWO definitions of 'current' in one system: (A) the DESIGNATION resolver getThreeSlots (CurrentSprint.ts:270) honors the owner's currentTaskUuid EXPLICIT-WINS-WHILE-VALID (make-current, R40.49) — read by pin/scoreboard; (B) a rogue parallel HEURISTIC derivedCurrentTaskUuid (server.ts:1388) that IGNORES the designation, loops all Tasks, keeps only deriveStatusEnum=='In Progress', picks max lastAdvancedAt — attachTaskPinRole (:1399) tags pinRole='current' off B and the action-bar rides B. So what Tron SETS != what RENDERS, and a QA-Review task can NEVER be current (In-Progress-only filter). FIX AT THE ROOT (one resolver, NOT a hardcode — a39efc32 appears nowhere in src): DELETE derivedCurrentTaskUuid; pinRole reads slots.current from the SAME compute-once getThreeSlots output as pin/scoreboard/tree; eligibility {Planned,In-Progress,QA-Review} everywhere; honest-absence on ambiguity. The gate must assert the HAZARD (a Task-selection loop returning a uuid by status/timestamp) not an actor-blocklist, and must be proven RED on TODAY's live defect before the fix.

The earlier {Planned, In-Progress, QA-Review} is REVERSED for QA-Review. See R40.60 AC-qa-review-advances-current.

model.computeOnceServerHole: ★ HOLE FOUND 2026-08-24 (architect 954dbf994): AC-compute-once-pass-down NAMED the 'slotsFrom twice with different inputs = still two sources' subtlety but NEVER ENFORCED it on the SERVER render path. #3 (Tron defect #5 live on v0.8.126): /api/trace/children?mode=trace calls slotsFrom with DIFFERENT/missing designation inputs, computing a slots that DISAGREES with the pin's slots.current = the compute-once hole, server-side. The drawer path (server.ts:2725) reads slots.current correctly; the /trace endpoint does not. FIX (#3 immediate): the endpoint reads the SAME per-request slots the pin uses (compute-once-pass-down), never its own slotsFrom call. This is the compute-once invariant landing on #3; the DURABLE closure is R37.24 (extended to scan the server tree). R40.56's compute-once AC was client-render-scoped in practice; R37.24 generalizes it to client-OR-server.
model.eligibilityCodeVsAcDivergence: ★ RULING 2026-08-24 (architect 2daa5fc83): (a) NARROW THE CODE - it's a bug; the ACs STAND (correct). :296 `d.status !== 'Done'` is an ad-hoc DENYLIST that only excludes Done -> a designated Superseded/Cancelled task WRONGLY becomes current, INCONSISTENT with the code's OWN terminal model (:230 TERMINAL_FOR_CURRENT + /superseded|cancelled/). DO NOT widen the ACs to not-Done (answer-fitting: it would sanction a Cancelled task as current + widen a spec to bless a code bug). FIX = membership in a NAMED DESIGNATION_ELIGIBLE set = {Planned, In-Progress, band, QA-Review} = 'not (Done|Superseded|Cancelled)', single-source (collapses the 3 ad-hoc exprs today: :277 auto-derived / :296 designation / :230 terminal). TWO legit-different axes, don't conflate: auto-derived-current(:277)={In Progress, band} (QA-Review rightly excluded from AUTO); designation-eligible(:296)={Planned, In-Progress, band, QA-Review}. NOT !d.terminal (.terminal includes QA-Review which IS designation-eligible) and NOT !==Done (leaks dead). GATE stub-must-fail: designate a Superseded OR Cancelled task -> must NOT be current = RED baseline on TODAY's code (which accepts it); + any ad-hoc status-compare for eligibility OUTSIDE the named set -> RED. eligibilityCodeVsAcDivergence CLEARS once the code narrows. Expert builds the :296 narrow-to-DESIGNATION_ELIGIBLE; architect backstops named-set + gate-reds-on-Cancelled-designation. ★ SEQUENCING (PO): the :296 narrow-to-DESIGNATION_ELIGIBLE is a SEPARATE bounded change AFTER #3 - the expert is FENCED off from folding it into #3's build (#3 is gate-first with its OWN RED baseline; two status-core changes in one build destroys attribution). So: #3 immediate FIRST, THEN the :296 narrow. ★★ FOLDED + SHRUNK 2026-08-26 (Tron 'status QA means next task', architect confirmed): the named DESIGNATION_ELIGIBLE allowlist SHRINKS to {Planned, In-Progress} (a designated task at QA-Review OR band now EXPIRES the designation too, :301 expires at QA-Review AND band, not just Done). ★ A named allowlist of exactly {Planned, In-Progress} EXCLUDES everything else BY CONSTRUCTION — Done/Superseded/Cancelled/QA-Review/band all fall out — so the earlier Superseded/Cancelled-LEAK worry (L-S40o) is MOOT/SUBSUMED. The :296 narrow-to-named-allowlist ruling HOLDS, its contents just shrink to {Planned,In-Progress}. L-S40o is NO LONGER a separate follow-on — it FOLDS INTO the R40.60 :301 change. Two axes: AUTO-DERIVE(:277)={In Progress}; DESIGNATION(:301)={Planned,In-Progress}.
model.singleSourceAccessorRuling: ★ ARCHITECT RULED (b) 2026-08-24: ONE currentSlots(idx) accessor that SELF-READS this.model.currentTaskUuid, used by BOTH the /api/trace/children endpoint AND the .slots getter/scoreboard. REJECTED (a) param-defaulting: a default still lets a caller pass a STALE or DIFFERENT currentTaskUuid -> the compute-once-with-different-inputs hole SURVIVES. A no-arg accessor that self-reads the designation removes the input divergence ENTIRELY - there is no SECOND way to compute it. Same elimination move as retiring pinRole (not refreshing it) + deleting the adapter (not syncing it). Architect OWNED design-sec-94 having the culprit side inverted (his static reading lost to the expert RUNNING it - static-reading != observation). This is the concrete accessor form of R40.56's single-definition-site + R37.24's read-never-reproduce; crossRef R37.24.
